stemMd: A cylinder has radius 2 cm and height 7 cm. What is its lateral surface area, excluding the circular ends?
explanationMd: Unrolling the curved surface gives a rectangle with width equal to circumference 2πr = 4π and height seven. Its area is 4π × 7 = 28π cm². The ends are explicitly excluded.

distractorRationale.d: This includes the two circular ends.
distractorRationale.b: This omits the factor two in the circumference.
distractorRationale.c: This uses volume units for an area.
distractorRationale.e: This is the combined area of the two ends.
